item.title: Version 1.0.7
item.changes: Apple Photos App: drag videos straight in from Photos. iPhone HDR: clips now look as they do in macOS, no longer blown out. Smoother playback: no flicker or stutter when editing clips while playing. Reveal in Media: Shift-F finds a timeline clip's file in Media. Replaced files: a file swapped or saved over with the same name is picked up. Fixes: Command-A and Delete on the timeline, vertical-to-wide switching, and no beep from the Match the sequence alert.
